checkoutSubmission: User clicked actual Place order after automation input delivery remained inconclusive; user reported success, agent independently inspected resulting confirmation.
procedureNotes: Some automation actions did not reach the UI reliably, including modal handling and background form submission. No application defect was inferred.
Chrome tabs.selected() did not establish real active state; management metadata was used to verify the actual target URL/active flag.
The user activated the test tab and later clicked Place order once; agent inspected confirmation and performed Cart/reload checks.
Malformed data and storage failures were tested with Node mocks against the actual helper, not by weakening browser settings.
